(other) 3501.05: Secretary of State acts through the new election integrity division
(other) 3501.055 (new): election integrity division investigates allegations of election fraud and voter suppression, takes public complaints, refers to prosecutors or other agencies, files an annual report each January 15, and may subpoena and hold hearings
(other) note: No voter ID, provisional ballot or proof-of-citizenship text (checked all marked words). Sole version.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
